text: Astral-Out-of-Home (the "Applicant") has made another application seeking five variances from the Sign By-law to allow for one non-illuminated third party wall sign (the "Proposed Sign") at the premises municipally known as 77 Elm Street (the "Premises"). A previous application for five variances concerning a sign at the Premises was the subject of consideration by the Sign Variance Committee at its September 19, 2017 meeting. The Proposed Sign measures 18.29 metres horizontally by 6.10 metres vertically, displaying static copy and is at a height of 15.85 metres. It is to be located on the southerly elevation of the above-grade parking garage section of the apartment building at the Premises, covering portions of the third, fourth and fifth storey (inclusive of a parapet wall projecting above the fifth storey). The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Granted the five variances requested to §§ 694-22C, 694-22D, 694-25B(1)(a), 694-25B(1)(b), and 694-25B(1)(c) required to allow the issuance of a permit for the erection and display of one third party wall sign at the property municipally known as 77 Elm Street, as described in Attachment 1 to the report dated March 29, 2018 from the Manager, Sign By-law Unit, Toronto Building.
